series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.
levelNote: All 62 items are jlpt 3, including contrast-side targets (さ, たち, 辺り, にくい): each visible choice includes a well-formed N3 option. No item needed N2.

answerPolicy.linker: Tendency items (がち, 気味, っぽい) put the linker inside the blank: options and answers are full forms such as 留守がちだ, 疲れ気味だった, 白っぽく.
answerPolicy.kana: Every typed answer also accepts the all-hiragana form of the key (e.g. ぬきがちだ, うごかしがたい), except katakana bases (ピクニック, アメリカ). Kanji variants of the ending are accepted where standard (勝ち, っ放し, 達, 難い on がたい keys only).
answerPolicy.atari: あたり interpretation items answer 割合 (わりあい, a rate per unit) or 近く (ちかく, approximately; near a time or place); kana forms accepted.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target. The base word is given in the instruction and typed inside the blank, so no lexical span overlaps it.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

findings.claim: 負けだらけ (noun 負け + だらけ) was also natural.
findings.change: Base changed to やられる (やられっぱなし); やられだらけ has no noun reading.

findings.claim: A tie-break instruction ('if both fit, choose がたい') keyed がたい where にくい is also natural.
findings.change: Tie-break removed; がたい keys rebuilt on fixed がたい-only collocations (動かしがたい事実, 許しがたい行為); 忘れがたい and 耐えがたい items deleted.

findings.claim: 'Noun for people' was too narrow.
findings.change: 'Noun naming the shared relation (often a person: 恋人; also 隣)'.

findings.claim: 子ども is not the plural-humble ども.
findings.change: Only 私ども is given.

findings.claim: 当たり was called a prefix.
findings.change: 'Suffix on a counter, before the amount'; 辺り covers place or time words.

findings.claim: The labels ごと／およそ were inaccurate glosses of the two senses.
findings.change: Labels are now 割合 and 近く, with kana spellings accepted.

findings.claim: 横向けに寝る is also used, so 向け was not wrong.
findings.change: Replaced by muki-positive (key tns-muki-maemuki, 前向きに考える); slot shapes are still keyed both ways and muki keeps 4 distinct keys.

reviews.finalVerdict: CLEAN after reconciliation; non-word っぽい distractors kept by coordinator decision
